rules.semantic: A hit is credited (kill-attribution stamp: id, team, tick) to the topmost LIVING on the attacker's owner chain (credit_head); when no living is on the chain (an orphaned weapon whose thrower is gone, a scripted ball fx), no stamp is written, so a death from that hit reads as an environment death and Lua on_kill / mode scoring pays nobody. walker_combat.cpp:323 passes credit_head() unchecked and relies on this guard; walker_specials.cpp:441-448 (turn undead) checks credit itself on the partial-damage arm but not on the lethal arm (also relies on this guard).

arms.when: no living on the attacker's owner chain (who==nullptr)
arms.observable: target->last_attacker_id() stays 0 / previous value, last_attacker_team stays -1; hp still drops; on death no killer passed to on_entity_death

note: null arm: no test found that hits with an owner chain holding no living and asserts last_attacker_id()==0 (test_mode_tick.cpp damage_gate_* assert 0 for zero/cancelled damage, which is the caller's tempdamage_i>0 gate, not this guard)
